notes: Machine-readable phase definitions. docs/PHASES.md is the narrative; a test keeps the two consistent. Thresholds marked 'proposed default' must be frozen in evals/<phase>-exit-tests.json before the phase moves to ready (AGENTS.md section 5.2). Later phases are milestone-level and get detailed when they become next.

phases.name: Grounded development environment
phases.deliverable: One genuinely reproducible simulator episode with its evidence chain (contract v1 export, initial-state-only replay, independent outcome), a locked simulator stack, a frozen evaluation specification, then a dataset containing both successes and failures.

exit_tests.statement: CPU-tier checks (contract tests, unit tests, lint, types, hash locks) pass before and after adapter work.
exit_tests.evidence: CI run ids on the merged commits
exit_tests.threshold: 100% of CPU-tier checks green

exit_tests.statement: One real simulator episode is exported through contracts/v1/writer.py and validates, including every referenced artifact hash, with a fully resolved stack lock.
exit_tests.evidence: validate.py output; config/stack-lock.resolved.json with no null simulator pins; episode hash
exit_tests.threshold: validate.py returns contract_valid; zero null pins in the simulator section

exit_tests.statement: Replay from the saved INITIAL state only, executing recorded actions through physics, reproduces the episode on the pinned stack across repeats.
exit_tests.evidence: replay report with per-step deviations, 3 repeats, same outcome label
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: max per-step deviation <= 0.001 (joints in rad; object and target positions in m) on all 3 repeats, identical outcome label (evals/M0-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: The task outcome is computed independently from simulator state by code that shares nothing with the policy or any reward model, agrees with inspection on one success and one failure episode, and every negative test is rejected.
exit_tests.evidence: outcome code hash; inspection notes; negative-test log (corrupted action semantics, broken hash, missing asset, wrong timebase, intermediate-state forcing)
exit_tests.threshold: 5/5 negative tests fail validation or invalidate the replay claim; 2/2 inspected outcomes agree

exit_tests.statement: The evaluation specification is frozen and hashed before any neural training: task rubric, split specification, group ids, policy-holdout plan (by training run/family), sealed opening budget, baselines.
exit_tests.evidence: evals/M0-protocol.md and evals/M0-exit-tests.json hashes cited in the report; status event 'frozen' for every M1 exit test
exit_tests.threshold: all listed files present and hashed; policy-holdout plan names run/family grouping

exit_tests.statement: A dataset of scripted and perturbed-policy episodes containing both successes and failures is collected, validated, and split-audited.
exit_tests.evidence: dataset manifest; audit_splits.py output; failure-mode breakdown
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: >= 200 episodes, >= 30% failures across >= 3 distinct failure modes, audit passes (evals/M0-exit-tests.json)

phases.name: Compact predictor, latent planner, action-chunk scorer
phases.deliverable: A state-based residual/ensemble predictor and a compact latent predictor with calibrated uncertainty; a sampling MPC planner compared against nominal-model MPC and a scripted baseline; an action-chunk scorer validated against executed simulator branches. No full-episode VLA claim.

exit_tests.statement: Multi-step prediction error versus horizon is reported for the learned predictors against constant/linear and nominal baselines on held-out dev episodes.
exit_tests.evidence: error-vs-horizon tables with confidence intervals; run ids
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: learned predictor RMSE at least 20% below the best baseline at every horizon 1..10 steps (evals/M1-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: Action sensitivity is validated against physics: from each restored initial state at least two alternative action chunks are executed in the simulator and the predictor's ranking of their outcomes agrees with the simulator's.
exit_tests.evidence: branch dataset manifest; ranking agreement table
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: >= 50 initial states; pairwise ordering accuracy >= 80% (evals/M1-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: Predictive uncertainty is calibrated against actual error on held-out data.
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: Spearman(predicted std, |error|) >= 0.5 and 90% interval coverage within +/- 10 points (evals/M1-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: Learned-model MPC is compared with nominal-model MPC and the scripted baseline on the frozen task suite with matched interaction budgets, reporting success with Wilson intervals, compute and latency.
exit_tests.evidence: comparison table; cost and latency lines
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: learned-model MPC success non-inferior to nominal within 5 points on m1-suite-1, or a reported negative result (evals/M1-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: The action-chunk scorer scores progress, clearance, constraint violations and uncertainty for logged prefixes plus candidate chunks, abstains when uncertain, and is validated against executed simulator branches. It makes no full-episode success claim.
exit_tests.evidence: scorer evaluation on branch dataset; abstention coverage
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: AUROC >= 0.75 for predicting a constraint violation; abstention rate and coverage reported (evals/M1-exit-tests.json)

phases.name: Closed-loop policy evaluator (simulation)
phases.deliverable: An action-conditioned observation model that supplies every input the evaluated VLA checkpoint expects, with branch-consistency tests, a separate success judge, calibration and abstention, validated on held-out policy runs in simulation.

exit_tests.statement: Policy-compatibility suite: the evaluator supplies images (resolution, history), proprioception, instruction and timing exactly as the checkpoint expects.
exit_tests.threshold: 100% of compatibility tests pass for each supported checkpoint family

exit_tests.statement: Branch consistency: evaluator rollouts of a checkpoint from restored initial states agree with simulator rollouts in outcome.
exit_tests.threshold: proposed default: outcome agreement >= 85% on dev initial states

exit_tests.statement: Ranking reliability on held-out policy runs (holdout by training run/family, never adjacent checkpoints).
exit_tests.evidence: ranking table on frozen checkpoint pairs
exit_tests.threshold: proposed default: Spearman >= 0.7; top-1 correct on >= 80% of pairs with a pre-declared visible gap

exit_tests.statement: False optimism is measured at the chosen decision threshold and the evaluator abstains with 'insufficient evidence' outside its validated range.
exit_tests.threshold: proposed default: false optimism <= 10%; abstention behaviour demonstrated on out-of-range inputs

exit_tests.statement: The success judge used for evaluation is independent of any training reward model, and reward-vs-judge disagreement tracking is in place.
exit_tests.threshold: no shared weights or labels between training reward and final judge; disagreement report produced

phases.name: Real-arm evaluator validation
phases.deliverable: Physical validation of the evaluator on the SO-101 under the frozen physical protocol: ranking on held-out real checkpoint pairs, false optimism, selection regret, episodes saved, with one authorized sealed-suite opening.

exit_tests.statement: The physical protocol is frozen (objects, placement template, camera mounts and calibration ids, reset procedure, timeout, rubric, sensors, blinding) and the rubric is double-labelled on about 20 mixed episodes.
exit_tests.evidence: protocol hash; agreement and confusion table
exit_tests.threshold: proposed default: reviewer agreement >= 90% with adjudication rules recorded

exit_tests.statement: Ranking on held-out real checkpoint pairs using matched placements with randomized within-pair order and paired analysis.
exit_tests.evidence: paired trial ledger; McNemar or exact paired test; effect-size intervals
exit_tests.threshold: proposed default: selection regret <= 5 points; false optimism <= 10%; sample size frozen from a precision plan

exit_tests.statement: Physical episodes saved at the validated selection error and cost per evaluated checkpoint are reported.
exit_tests.threshold: reported with denominators; no threshold on the value itself

exit_tests.statement: One sealed confirmation suite is opened once under logged owner authorization and the result is reported regardless of outcome.
exit_tests.threshold: exactly one opening; frozen candidate hashes recorded before access

phases.name: Synthetic-data engine (SFT route)
phases.deliverable: Two separate pipelines (action-conditioned rollouts; generated demonstrations plus inverse dynamics) on matched, reconstructible simulated scenes; a physics-replay executability filter; a matched-budget downstream ablation on the SFT route; cost per accepted trajectory.

exit_tests.statement: Generation starts from initial frames rendered from known simulator scenes whose initial state and asset hashes were saved first; scene-consistency checks reject injected mismatches.
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: 100% of 60 injected mismatches rejected, at most 3 of 60 controls falsely rejected (evals/M3-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: Inverse-dynamics actions are replayed from the initial state only and judged on task predicates; executability and false accept/reject rates are measured on an audited sample.
exit_tests.threshold: proposed default: false acceptance <= 10% on >= 100 audited trajectories

exit_tests.statement: Matched-budget downstream ablation on the SFT route: real-only, real plus ordinary augmentation, real plus generated, with multiple seeds and held-out success with intervals.
exit_tests.threshold: proposed default: >= 3 seeds per arm; a benefit is claimed only if real+generated beats real+augmentation by a frozen margin; a negative result is a valid delivery

exit_tests.statement: Total generation, filtering and training cost per accepted trajectory is reported including rejected generations.
exit_tests.threshold: reported; no threshold on the value

exit_tests.statement: Generated demonstrations feed only the SFT route; GRPO uses on-policy samples only.
exit_tests.threshold: no code path routes IDM-labelled data into the GRPO objective

exit_tests.statement: Targeted synthetic failure data improves prediction on a failure family held out from training (owner D2, 2026-11-06).
exit_tests.evidence: evaluation-family RMSE tables for arms F0, F1, F1s, F2, F3 and F_star; no-harm seed-holdout reductions
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: F3 beats F1 at every horizon 1 to 10, on both streams and all three seeds, and loses at most 2 points on the no-harm holdout (evals/M3-exit-tests.json)

phases.name: Drone dynamics adaptation (offline and shadow only)
phases.deliverable: A residual-dynamics model for the drone trained on imported SITL and later real flight logs, with calibrated uncertainty and a proposed trust gate, evaluated offline and in shadow mode; an exported model manifest at the contract boundary. No command authority.

exit_tests.statement: Drone episodes are imported read-only through the contract and validate.
exit_tests.threshold: frozen: 100% of imported episodes contract_valid (evals/M4-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: The residual model predicts 1 s of open-loop motion better than the nominal model on held-out flight families (evals/M4-exit-tests.json).
exit_tests.evidence: per-family and aggregate step-20 position RMSE for nominal and learned models on identical windows; exclusions by family; bootstrap intervals
exit_tests.threshold: frozen (owner, 2026-11-06): learned RMSE <= 0.85 x nominal RMSE, where RMSE is the square root of the equal-weight mean over held-out families of each family's mean squared 3-D position error at step 20 of a 20-step open-loop rollout (evals/M4-exit-tests.json)

exit_tests.statement: Uncertainty is calibrated and a gating rule (trust the learned model only when calibrated uncertainty is below a bound) is proposed and evaluated offline; shadow predictions are logged only.
exit_tests.evidence: calibration table; shadow log; code audit
exit_tests.threshold: no code path can emit a setpoint; gating rule documented with offline evidence

exit_tests.statement: An exported model manifest (contracts/v1/model-manifest.template.json) records inputs, normalization, timestep, horizon, uncertainty outputs and validity limits; command_authority is false.
exit_tests.threshold: manifest complete; command_authority == false

phases.name: Future: verifier at test time (best-of-N action chunks)
phases.deliverable: Milestone-level: sample N action chunks from the VLA, score with the validated scorer/judge, execute the best; measure real-arm success versus N and versus RL fine-tuning. Detailed when it becomes next.

exit_tests.statement: Real-arm success versus N is measured with paired trials against N=1 and the GRPO-tuned policy.
exit_tests.threshold: to be frozen when the phase becomes next

exit_tests.statement: Compute per episode and the N at which gains stop are reported.
exit_tests.threshold: reported

phases.name: Future: verifier as reward for real-robot RL
phases.deliverable: Milestone-level: HIL-SERL-style online RL on the real arm where the learned success judge replaces as many human labels as it safely can; final assessment stays independent. Detailed when it becomes next.

exit_tests.statement: Human labels saved at matched success are measured; reward-vs-independent-assessment disagreement is tracked throughout.
exit_tests.threshold: to be frozen when the phase becomes next

exit_tests.statement: Failure modes (reward hacking, false optimism) are documented with examples.
exit_tests.threshold: reported

phases.name: Future: data curation loop
phases.deliverable: Milestone-level: which experience goes back into training (all, quality-filtered, failure-weighted, synthetic-augmented) with scaling curves of real success versus data volume and quality. Detailed when it becomes next.

exit_tests.statement: Scaling curves of held-out real success versus data volume and curation strategy with intervals.
exit_tests.threshold: to be frozen when the phase becomes next

phases.name: Future: new embodiment (LEAP hand on a stand)
phases.deliverable: Milestone-level: reuse the schema, evaluator and pipeline for the hand; question: can an evaluator trained in sim pick the better real in-hand policy without real episodes? Detailed when it becomes next.

exit_tests.statement: Selection regret versus real on held-out hand policies, with and without cheap tactile input.
exit_tests.threshold: to be frozen when the phase becomes next
